popup_next_schedule.description: Footer line of the toolbar popup naming when the next scheduled session starts. DAY is a short weekday name, TIME is a 24 hour clock time.

popup_settings_button_label.description: Accessible name of the cog button in the popup header. It opens the extension's Settings page.

popup_open_settings_failed.message: Could not open Settings. Try again.
popup_open_settings_failed.description: Error shown in the popup when the browser refused to open the Settings page.

popup_settings_load_failed.message: Could not load session settings. Reload the popup to try again. Defaults are shown.
popup_settings_load_failed.description: Error above the start form when the worker did not answer with usable settings, so the form shows its built-in defaults.

popup_open_setup_failed.message: Could not open setup. Try again.
popup_open_setup_failed.description: Error in the popup when the first-run setup page could not be opened.

popup_setup_required_heading.description: Heading of the popup screen shown while first-run setup is unfinished. Focus Lock is the product name and stays untranslated.

popup_setup_required_body.message: Choose your starting lists, website access, and storage mode before starting a session.
popup_setup_required_body.description: Body of the popup screen shown while first-run setup is unfinished.

popup_open_setup_button.description: Button in the popup that opens the first-run setup page.

popup_blocking_confirm_failed.message: Could not confirm website blocking. Try again.
popup_blocking_confirm_failed.description: Error in the popup when the worker's answer about website blocking could not be read.

popup_blocking_enable_failed.message: Could not enable website blocking. Try again.
popup_blocking_enable_failed.description: Error in the popup when turning website blocking on failed.

popup_blocking_off_heading.description: Heading of the popup screen shown when the extension has no website access, so no session can start.

popup_blocking_off_body.message: Focus Lock cannot start a session until Chrome grants website access and blocking is enabled.
popup_blocking_off_body.description: Body of the popup screen shown when website blocking is off. Focus Lock is the product name and Chrome is the browser name.

popup_blocking_off_denied.message: Chrome did not grant website access. Website blocking is still off.
popup_blocking_off_denied.description: Status line in the popup after the browser's permission prompt was declined.

popup_blocking_off_registration_error.message: Website access is granted, but Focus Lock could not enable blocking. Retry setup or reload the extension.
popup_blocking_off_registration_error.description: Status line in the popup when the permission exists but the blocking rules could not be registered.

popup_enable_blocking_button.description: Button in the popup that asks the browser for website access and turns blocking on.

popup_retry_button.description: Button that runs the failed step again. Used on the website blocking, boot failure, and setup status screens of the popup.

popup_notice_access_revoked.message: Your session ended because website access was removed.
popup_notice_access_revoked.description: Notice in the popup explaining why a running session stopped.

popup_notice_blocking_failed.message: Your session ended because Focus Lock could not enable website blocking.
popup_notice_blocking_failed.description: Notice in the popup explaining why a running session stopped. Focus Lock is the product name.

popup_dismiss_notice_failed.message: Could not dismiss this notice. Try again.
popup_dismiss_notice_failed.description: Error shown when dismissing the website access notice in the popup failed.

popup_dismiss_notice_label.description: Accessible name of the button that hides the website access notice in the popup.

popup_dismiss_button.description: Visible label of the button that hides the website access notice in the popup.

popup_restart_failed.message: Could not restart Focus Lock. Try again.
popup_restart_failed.description: Error on the popup's recovery screen when a retry or a runtime reset failed. Focus Lock is the product name.

popup_boot_failed_heading.description: Heading of the popup's recovery screen, shown when the background worker failed to start. Focus Lock is the product name.

popup_boot_reason_unavailable.message: The reason could not be read.
popup_boot_reason_unavailable.description: Shown on the popup's recovery screen when the worker could not report why it failed to start.

popup_reset_runtime_button.description: Button on the popup's recovery screen that clears the stored session state and keeps everything else.

popup_reset_runtime_note.message: Keeps your settings, lists, and statistics. Clears the current session state.
popup_reset_runtime_note.description: Explanation under the Reset local runtime button on the popup's recovery screen.

popup_delete_all_confirm_button.description: Confirmation button on the popup's recovery screen that deletes all stored extension data.

popup_keep_data_button.description: Button on the popup's recovery screen that cancels the delete-everything confirmation.

popup_delete_all_button.description: Button on the popup's recovery screen that asks to confirm deleting all stored data. Focus Lock is the product name.

popup_setup_status_unavailable.message: Setup status unavailable. Reload Focus Lock to try again.
popup_setup_status_unavailable.description: Alert in the popup when the stored setup record could not be read. Focus Lock is the product name.

popup_snapshot_unavailable.description: Shown in the popup when the live session status could not be read from the worker.

popup_action_in_progress.description: Reason a button in the active session view is disabled: an earlier command has not answered yet.

popup_active_site_checking.description: Reason the unlock button is disabled while the popup is still reading the current tab's address.

popup_active_site_unsupported.message: Open a regular website to unlock it
popup_active_site_unsupported.description: Reason the unlock button is disabled because the current tab is not an ordinary web page.

popup_active_site_unknown.message: Could not identify the active site
popup_active_site_unknown.description: Reason the unlock button is disabled after reading the current tab failed. Shown inside the button, without a full stop.

popup_active_site_error.message: Could not identify the active site.
popup_active_site_error.description: Alert under the active session view after reading the current tab failed. A sentence, unlike the shorter reason inside the button.

popup_resume_now.description: Button in the active session view that ends a pause and returns to focus.

popup_start_next_focus_early.description: Button in the active session view that ends a break before its timer runs out.

popup_unlock_this_site.description: Label of the button that spends earned credit to open the current site, and of the matching confirm button in the deliberation panel.

popup_unlock_all_sites.description: Label of the button that spends earned credit to pause blocking entirely, and of the matching confirm button in the deliberation panel.

popup_spend_cost.description: Second line of an unlock button: how long the unlock lasts and how much earned credit it costs. Both are clock durations such as 5:00.

popup_spend_cost_host.description: Second line of the unlock button for one site: the length, the cost, and the site it applies to. ACCESS and CREDIT are clock durations, HOST is a domain name.

popup_choose_work_tab_button.description: Button in the active session view that opens the work tab picker when no work tab is set.

popup_change_work_tab_button.description: Button in the active session view that opens the work tab picker when a work tab is already set.

popup_session_actions_summary.description: Label of the collapsed disclosure in the active session view holding the end, unlock, and work tab controls.

popup_site_access_credit.description: How much earned credit is available, shown above the session actions. CREDIT is a clock duration.

popup_add_allowed_domain_label.description: Label of the text field for adding a site to this session's allowed list.

popup_allowed_domain_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the allowed domain field. An example domain, so keep a domain that reads as an example in the target language.

popup_add_allowed_domain_button.description: Accessible name of the plus button beside the allowed domain field.

popup_add_button.description: Visible label of the plus button beside the allowed domain field.

popup_draft_allowed_only.message: Only $COUNT$ allowed site rules. Other websites blocked.
popup_draft_allowed_only.description: Summary beside the start button for a session that allows only the listed sites. COUNT is how many allow rules the session carries.

popup_draft_blocked_summary.description: Summary beside the start button for a session that blocks the selected categories. CATEGORIES is how many categories are on, RULES is how many extra rules were added.

popup_draft_stop_hard.description: Summary beside the start button saying the session cannot be ended before its timer runs out.

popup_draft_stop_flexible.description: Summary beside the start button saying the session can be ended whenever the user chooses.

popup_draft_stop_friction.description: Summary beside the start button for a session that can be ended after a deliberation wait. SECONDS is that wait in seconds, and s is the abbreviation for seconds.

popup_draft_stop_friction_phrase.message: End after a $SECONDS$s wait and confirmation phrase.
popup_draft_stop_friction_phrase.description: Summary beside the start button for a session that can be ended after a deliberation wait and a typed sentence. SECONDS is that wait in seconds.

popup_session_length_label.description: Label above the duration presets in the start form, and the accessible name of the group holding them.

popup_custom_minutes_label.description: Accessible name of the number field for typing a session length the presets do not offer.

popup_custom_minutes_placeholder.description: Placeholder in the custom session length field, abbreviating minutes. Keep it short enough for a narrow field.

popup_gate_force_end.description: Button in the deliberation panel that skips the wait. Worded exactly as the matching Settings checkbox names it.

popup_gate_keep_focusing.description: Button in the deliberation panel that closes it and leaves the session running.

popup_gate_phrase_label.description: Label before the sentence the user has to type to confirm. The sentence itself follows it.

popup_gate_update_failed.message: Could not update the gate. Try again.
popup_gate_update_failed.description: Error in the deliberation panel when confirming or closing it failed.

popup_gate_intention.description: Reminder in the deliberation panel of what the user wrote they were working on. INTENTION is their own sentence.

popup_gate_wait_prefix.description: Start of the countdown line in the deliberation panel. The elapsed seconds follow it, then popup_gate_wait_remaining, forming one sentence.

popup_gate_wait_remaining.description: End of the countdown line in the deliberation panel, after popup_gate_wait_prefix and the elapsed seconds. TOTAL is the whole wait in seconds, and s abbreviates seconds.

popup_back_to_work.description: Visible label of the button that switches to the tab chosen as the work tab.

popup_destination_unavailable.description: Shown in place of the work tab's name when that tab can no longer be named.

popup_back_to_work_name.description: Accessible name of the work tab button when only the tab's title or host is known. DESTINATION is that title or host.

popup_back_to_work_name_host.description: Accessible name of the work tab button when both are known. DESTINATION is the tab's title, HOSTNAME is its domain.

popup_categories_locked.message: Category editing is disabled until blocked-site lists reload.
popup_categories_locked.description: Why the category toggles in the start form refuse to change, shown beside them.

popup_blocked_categories_heading.description: Heading above the category toggles in the start form's rule summary.

popup_show_full_domain.description: Accessible name of a rule row in the start form, which opens a popover with the whole domain. PATTERN is that domain.

popup_show_full_regex.description: Accessible name of a rule row in the start form, which opens a popover with the whole pattern. PATTERN is that regular expression.

popup_rule_kind_domain.description: Kind label on a rule row that matches a domain name.

popup_rule_kind_regex.description: Kind label on a rule row that matches with a regular expression.

popup_category_sites_label.description: Accessible name of the site list under one category in the start form. CATEGORY is the category's own title, such as Social.

popup_sites_one.description: How many sites one category blocks, shown on its toggle. Singular.

popup_sites_other.description: How many sites one category blocks, shown on its toggle. Plural.

popup_more_sites_one.description: Follows the first few sites of a category in the start form, counting the ones not listed. Singular.

popup_more_sites_other.description: Follows the first few sites of a category in the start form, counting the ones not listed. Plural.

popup_allowed_exceptions_heading.description: Heading above the sites that stay reachable even though their category is blocked.

popup_extra_blocked_heading.description: Heading above the rules blocked beyond the selected categories.

popup_no_extra_blocked.description: Shown under the Extra blocked rules heading when the session adds none.

popup_allowed_heading.description: Heading above the allow list of a session that blocks everything else.

popup_no_allowed_sites.description: Shown under the Allowed sites and rules heading when the allow list is empty.

popup_what_will_be_blocked.description: Heading of the rule summary for a session that blocks the selected categories.

popup_what_will_be_allowed.description: Heading of the rule summary for a session that allows only the listed sites.

popup_categories_selected.description: How many blocked categories are on, in the rule summary. SELECTED is the number chosen, TOTAL is how many exist.

popup_extra_blocked_rules_one.description: How many rules are blocked beyond the selected categories, in the rule summary. Singular.

popup_extra_blocked_rules_other.description: How many rules are blocked beyond the selected categories, in the rule summary. Plural.

popup_allowed_rules_one.description: How many allow rules a session carries, in the rule summary. Singular.

popup_allowed_rules_other.description: How many allow rules a session carries, in the rule summary. Plural.

popup_scope_whitelist.message: Allowed-site and rule changes here apply only to this session. Everything else is blocked.
popup_scope_whitelist.description: Explains that edits in the start form's rule summary do not change the permanent lists, for a session that allows only the listed sites.

popup_scope_blacklist.message: Category and rule changes here apply only to this session.
popup_scope_blacklist.description: Explains that edits in the start form's rule summary do not change the permanent lists.

popup_open_settings_defaults.description: Button in the start form's rule summary that opens the Settings page, where the permanent lists live.

popup_rule_details_label.description: Accessible name of the scrolling region holding the rule lists in the start form.

popup_session_type_legend.description: Label of the group of choices deciding how hard the session is to end.

popup_session_type_flexible.description: Session type that can be ended at any moment.

popup_session_type_friction.description: Session type that can be ended only after a deliberation wait.

popup_session_type_hard.description: Session type that cannot be ended before its timer runs out.

popup_session_type_flexible_hint.message: End the session immediately whenever you choose.
popup_session_type_flexible_hint.description: What choosing the Flexible session type means.

popup_session_type_friction_hint.message: Ending early requires $WAIT$. No typing is required.
popup_session_type_friction_hint.description: What choosing the Friction session type means when no sentence has to be typed. WAIT is a phrase such as a 10-second wait or no wait.

popup_session_type_friction_hint_phrase.message: Ending early requires $WAIT$ and typed confirmation.
popup_session_type_friction_hint_phrase.description: What choosing the Friction session type means when a sentence has to be typed. WAIT is a phrase such as a 10-second wait or no wait.

popup_session_type_hard_hint.message: The session cannot end early. Site access credit still works.
popup_session_type_hard_hint.description: What choosing the Hard lock session type means.

popup_mode_blacklist_hint.message: The selected categories and extra rules are blocked. Other sites remain available.
popup_mode_blacklist_hint.description: Hint under the blocking mode that blocks only what the user selected.

popup_mode_whitelist_hint.message: Only the listed sites are available. Every other website is blocked.
popup_mode_whitelist_hint.description: Hint under the blocking mode that allows only what the user listed.

popup_invalid_duration_error.message: Enter a session length greater than zero minutes.
popup_invalid_duration_error.description: Error when the start button was pressed with an unusable custom session length.

popup_stale_lists_unavailable.message: Defaults changed, but current lists could not be loaded. Reload the popup.
popup_stale_lists_unavailable.description: Error when the permanent lists changed while the start form was open and the new ones could not be read.

popup_no_work_tab_option.description: Option in the work tab picker meaning the session runs without a work tab.

popup_work_tab_unavailable_option.description: Option in the work tab picker standing for a chosen tab that has since closed or become ineligible.

popup_cycles_label.message: Cycles: $FOCUS$ min focus, $SHORT_BREAK$ min break, $LONG_BREAK$ min long break every $LONG_EVERY$th
popup_cycles_label.description: Label of the checkbox that breaks a session into focus and break blocks. The first three values are lengths in minutes, LONG_EVERY is which break is the long one, read as an ordinal.

popup_intention_label.description: Label of the field where the user writes what this session is for.

popup_intention_placeholder.description: Placeholder in the intention field of the start form.

popup_work_tab_named.description: Names the tab the session returns to. TITLE is that tab's own title, or a stand-in such as No work tab (optional).

popup_change_button.description: Text button beside the chosen work tab in the start form. It opens the work tab picker.

popup_session_settings_summary.description: Label of the collapsed disclosure in the start form holding every setting for this session.

popup_choose_work_tab_label.description: Label above the work tab dropdown in the start form.

popup_work_tab_select_label.description: Accessible name of the dropdown listing the tabs that can be the work tab.

popup_work_tab_current_option.description: Option for the tab the user is on right now. TITLE is that tab's own title, and the parenthesis marks it as the current one.

popup_blocking_mode_legend.description: Label of the group choosing between blocking the selected sites and allowing only the listed ones.

popup_invalid_time_label.description: Stands in for the session length on the start button while the typed length cannot be used. Reads inside a sentence, so it is lower case.

popup_start_focus_label.description: The start button of a timed session. DURATION is a length such as 50 min, or the invalid time stand-in.

popup_invalid_domain_error.message: Enter a valid domain such as docs.example.com.
popup_invalid_domain_error.description: Error under the allowed domain field when what was typed is not a domain.

popup_work_tabs_unavailable.message: Could not load work tabs. Reopen the popup to try again.
popup_work_tabs_unavailable.description: Error when the list of tabs that can be the work tab could not be read.

popup_use_this_tab.description: Button that makes the tab the user is on right now the work tab.

popup_current_tab_unavailable.message: This tab is not available for work. Choose another open tab.
popup_current_tab_unavailable.description: Hint under Use this tab when the current tab cannot be the work tab, because the session's own rules block it.

popup_checking_current_tab.description: Hint under Use this tab while the current tab is being re-read after the button was pressed.

popup_finding_current_tab.description: Hint under Use this tab while the eligible tabs are still loading.

popup_current_tab_load_failed.message: Could not load your current tab. Try again.
popup_current_tab_load_failed.description: Hint under Use this tab after reading the current tab failed.

popup_choose_work_tab_copy.message: Choose or replace your work tab.
popup_choose_work_tab_copy.description: Line above the work tab controls in the active session view while no work tab is set.

popup_saving_work_tab.description: Status while the chosen work tab is being saved to the running session.

popup_save_work_tab_failed.message: Could not save the work tab. Try again.
popup_save_work_tab_failed.description: Error when saving the chosen work tab to the running session failed.

popup_choose_open_tab_option.description: First option of the work tab dropdown in the active session view, standing for no choice made yet.

popup_or_choose_another_tab.description: Label above the work tab dropdown in the active session view, offered next to Use this tab.

popup_start_failed.message: Could not start session. Try again.
popup_start_failed.description: Error when the worker's answer to a start request could not be read.
